reading_note: The arc traces how divine truth proceeds from the Lord as a "letter" — a coherent communication of love and wisdom — sent down to awaken what has fallen into self-love, and how that truth, having recorded every state of conflict and every response, becomes the medium of return. The teaching shows that the Calling (truth descending) and the Answer (truth ascending in reception) form one circuit, and that the Mind of Light from Christ is the same epistolary structure operating at a deeper interior register.
